violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not present at the beginning of the inspection
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: A hookah bowl was observed being stored in the basin of the kitchen hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC REMOVED THE HOOKAH BOWL OUT OF THE HAND SINK. HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Paper towels were not observed at the kitchen hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REFILLED THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER. PAPER TOWELS MUST BE PROVIDED AT ALL HAND SINKS TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Observed no date marking system throughout the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A DATE MARKING HAND OUT. DATE MARK ALL FOODS THAT ARE TO BE STORED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: A canister of fire suppression chemical was observed being stored in the hopper of a meat grinder found on top of the 2DR prep top cooler
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC MOVED THE FIRE SUPPRESSION CHEMICAL OUT OF THE FOOD PREPARATION AREA.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed unlabeled spray bottles of cleaning chemicals
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC LABELED THE SPRAY BOTTLES DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED IN THE THREE-DOOR STAND-UP - RAW BEEF ON A SHELF ABOVE COOKED LENTILS AND COOKED ONIONS
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: RAW MEAT MOVED DURING INSPECTION TO LOWER SHELF.

violations.title: Food Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device is not accurate in degrees F. OBSERVED FOOD THERMOMETER TO READ 28F UNDER 32F CONDITIONS WHEN CALIBRATED WITH EHS’S FOOD THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/- 2 degrees F in the intended range of use. CDI: NEW DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER ORDERED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE YOU CALIBRATE YOUR THERMOMETER REGULARLY (AS SHOWN DURING INSPECTION) TO ENSURE IT IS ACCURATE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BEER STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE DRY STORAGE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ALL FOOD INCLUDING ALCOHOL MUST BE STORED ON SHELVING 6 INCHES ABOVE THE FLOOR. PUT THE BEER ON THE SHELVES IN THIS ROOM BY MAY 20, 2026.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. CDI: BLEACH WAS PURCHASED AND BROUGHT TO FACILITY DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FLOOR, WALLS, INSIDE OF SHELVING, AROUND PLUMBING ON THE FLOOR, AND UNDER AND BEHIND EQUIPMENT IN THE BAR AND KITCHEN TO HAVE A BUILD UP OF GREASE AND OTHER DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. FACILITY MUST BE DEEP CLEANED IN ALL AREAS LISTED ABOVE BY MAY 20, 2026.

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises. OBSERVED A SIGNIFICANT AMOUNT OF ITEMS INCLUDING COOKING EQUIPMENT, BOXES OF FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES, AND DECORATIONS STORED IN THE DRY STORAGE AND ARE NOT USED.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. REMOVE ALL ITEMS THAT YOU DO NOT USE OR NEED BY MAY 20, 2026. YOU WILL HAVE MORE SPACE TO STORE ESSENTIAL ITEMS ON THE SHELVING AS REQUIRED. Fidel Restaurant & Lounge (Inspection Date: 02/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED BEFORE THE END OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT VA EMAIL.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: kitfo
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PIC WILL CORRECT THE MENU WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED LIVE COCKROACH IN THE BATHROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC WILL RECEIVE PEST CONTROL AND PROVIDE INVOICE WITHIN 10 DAYS

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed that the hood in the kitchen was not functioning.
violations.corrective_action: Facility had someone fix the hood so it was functioning. Fire marshal conducted an inspection and will work with the facility to correct other hood issues.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed the grease trap under the 3 compartment sink leaking water when the faucet is turned on.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. A PLUMBER WAS CALLED AND WAS ABLE TO REPAIR THE GREASE TRAP SO THAT IT WAS NO LONGER LEAKING.
